exposure: Lipid network modules (specifically acylcarnitine lipid module)
outcome: ADHD symptoms at 2 years of age
ASD symptoms at 2 years of age
cohort: The study included 1074 mother-child pairs (52.3% male children) from the Barwon Infant Study cohort.
finding: The acylcarnitine lipid module in cord blood is associated with ADHD and ASD symptoms at 2 years of age, and higher birth acylcarnitine levels partly mediated the effects of risk factors such as low income, Apgar score, and maternal inflammation on these outcomes.
